Sandbox_RenewableEnergy_SunlightMultipli:
Multiplies what solar panels make.
1 is what 1993 panels really made in Kentucky: about 190 Wh a day per 50 W module on a tilted rack in an average July and 120 in December, against the 2 kWh a day a fridge-freezer uses.
Raise it if you'd rather not spend the game chasing panels.
Sandbox_RenewableEnergy_BiogasMultiplier:
Multiplies the gas digesters make from their feed.
1 is what a real digester makes. The game's animals drop a cow's manure about every other day where a real cow makes 30 kg a day, so 1 needs a big herd.
Sandbox_RenewableEnergy_BatteryWear_tool:
Percent of the wear batteries take from deep discharges.
0 turns wear off.
Sandbox_RenewableEnergy_FailsafeStartCha: A failsafe starts its backup generator when the battery bank's charge falls below this percent.
Sandbox_RenewableEnergy_FailsafeStopChar: A failsafe stops its backup generator when the battery bank's charge reaches this percent.
Sandbox_RenewableEnergy_SolarSites_toolt:
Percent chance that each of the map's solar sites (farms, campers, relay sheds, ranger stations, the power yard, road works and army checkpoints) is set up, rolled once when the world is created.
The road works north of Muldraugh and the checkpoint on the highway south of Louisville are always there unless this is 0.
Sandbox_RenewableEnergy_GardenLights_too:
Percent of the usual chance that a house has solar garden lights along its front, rolled once per house the first time someone sees it.
0 turns them off.
Sandbox_RenewableEnergy_LRMSolarPanels_t:
Multiplies how often solar modules spawn as loot, in containers, vehicles and the mod's solar crates.
0 turns them off.
Sandbox_RenewableEnergy_LRMBatteries_too:
Multiplies how often deep cycle and L-16 batteries and battery electrolyte spawn as loot, in containers, vehicles and solar crates, and how many batteries the battery banks the mod places hold.
0 turns them off.
Sandbox_RenewableEnergy_LRMMisc_tooltip:
Multiplies how often inverters, charge controllers, solar battery maintainers, solar battery chargers, solar garden lights, the failsafe and the Homestead Power magazines spawn as loot, in containers, vehicles, crates and placed battery banks, and how often a placed bank holds a car battery charger.
0 turns them off.
Sandbox_RenewableEnergy_ChargeFreq_toolt: How often battery banks work out their charge and load. Every hour costs less on a busy server.
Sandbox_RenewableEnergy_BatteryBankSpawn: How often sheds, garages, storage units and farm and electronics storage rooms hold a stocked battery box or rack, and garages and storage units a crate of solar gear, the first time someone sees them.
Sandbox_RenewableEnergy_StashMode_toolti:
Stash houses hold a crate of solar gear.
Map items: their annotated maps drop from corpses.
Random initial: most of them are stocked from the start, without a map.
Change only on new game.
Sandbox_RenewableEnergy_StashMode_option: Add map items and random initial
Sandbox_RenewableEnergy_ConnectPanelMin_: Base number of in-game minutes it takes to connect one panel.
Sandbox_RenewableEnergy_StormDamage_tool: Thunderstorms with strong wind can crack solar modules. Wall panels are safe, metal mounts hold up better than wooden ones.
Sandbox_RenewableEnergy_StormDamageRate_:
Percent of the chance that a thunderstorm cracks a solar module.
100 cracks about one module every two to three months on ten panels.
